ranked.headline: Models infer regulatory and temporal dynamics from single-cell transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Single-cell snapshots are now analyzed with explicit dynamical, causal, and perturbation-aware models rather than descriptive visualization alone.

ranked.headline: New tools resolve chromatin structure, haplotypes, and isoform-level splicing
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing and multi-omics integration now yield haplotype-resolved, near-complete genomes and isoform-level readouts in reproducible form.

ranked.headline: Sequence models map motifs, nucleosomes and CpG methylation across chromatin
ranked.summary: Deep learning and motif-based models now predict chromatin accessibility, enhancers and methylation directly from DNA sequence.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning predicts protein binding, interactions, and complex structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply protein language model embeddings to binding affinity, epitopes, and structure reliability assessment from sequence.

ranked.headline: Sampling frames constrain what pathogen inference can recover from surveillance data
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs transmission models, genomic, wastewater and serological data to infer infection status from distinct sampling frames.

ranked.headline: Learned and calibrated scores prioritize noncoding variants and transcript isoforms
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs sequence-based deep learning with region-specific score calibration and isoform-resolved long-read analysis for regulatory interpretation.

ranked.headline: Microbial multi-omics and proteome annotation link taxa to host disease phenotypes
ranked.summary: Integrated multi-omics and functional annotation resources are now resolving taxon-level dysbiosis and proteome-level traits across host-microbe systems.

ranked.headline: Optimal transport and graph geometry align unpaired omics and imaging modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address alignment of unpaired spatial and single-cell modalities without shared barcodes or features.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for denoising, imputing, and mapping single-cell transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and new models now address dropout, batch integration, and cell-type deconvolution across single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models now predict genomic variant effects, mutation rates and splicing
ranked.summary: Learned models of sequence, protein and population data are now applied to variant-level genomic questions across several species and platforms.

ranked.headline: Single-cell foundation models gain spatial, graph, and chromatin context for prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair pretrained single-cell and sequence encoders with spatial, graph, or transport constraints for expression and network prediction.

ranked.headline: MD simulations show α1-antitrypsin droplets hardening into β-sheet assemblies
ranked.summary: Simulations now link defined transitions, such as droplet hardening and lipid-guided dimer alignment, to predicted state changes.

ranked.headline: Ligands and mutations reshape dynamics of disordered and allosteric proteins
ranked.summary: MD, NMR, and Markov state modeling now resolve ligand binding paths and dynamic states in disordered and allosteric proteins.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes and banded alignment cut memory cost in sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Growing sequence collections and long-read data make memory footprint and index size central to similarity search and alignment.

ranked.headline: Null GWAS test bias, expression-noise QTLs and plasma metabolite causal mapping
ranked.summary: Omitted epistasis inflates GWAS null statistics, while atlases of noise and metabolite QTLs link genetic variation to complex-trait mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of cell identity and spatial organization from transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: New methods link histology morphology to cell types and spatial expression while benchmarks refine imaging platforms and gene selection.

ranked.headline: Graph and latent models of brain connectivity from EEG, SEEG, fMRI and connectomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply graph-based and latent-variable learning to multimodal brain recordings and structural connectomes, extending beyond per-recording…

ranked.headline: Deep learning for segmenting, detecting, and quantifying structures in microscopy images
ranked.summary: Recent work applies weakly supervised, transformer, and diffusion methods to brightfield, fluorescence, and whole-slide biomedical image analysis.

ranked.headline: Reproducible R and Nextflow pipelines for spatial, multi-omics, and network-based analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published package document end-to-end workflows that make spatial, multi-omics, and network analyses reproducible.

ranked.headline: Topology and higher-order complexes are redefining how brain network structure is…
ranked.summary: Recent work tests topological and higher-order information measures as alternatives to pairwise brain connectivity representations.

ranked.headline: Sequence models conditioned on evolutionary and structural context guide protein design
ranked.summary: Recent work couples protein language and inverse folding models to evolutionary and structural context, extending design to general-purpose LLMs.

ranked.headline: New preprints advance haplotype, lineage and methylation analysis on genomic references
ranked.summary: Four preprints from November 2025 introduce workflows for Y-chromosome, somatic, single-cell and methylation analyses.

ranked.headline: Tools for nanopore methylation motifs, microbial SNP ranking and metagenomic profiling
ranked.summary: Recent publications pair nanopore basecaller data, metagenomic SNP scoring and containerized pipelines with reproducible, scalable analysis.

ranked.headline: Sequence models for peptide properties, antimicrobials and compound-protein binding
ranked.summary: Debiased benchmarks and explainable attribution are now being applied to sequence-based peptide and interaction predictors.

ranked.headline: Learned interaction and noise structure in high-dimensional omics regression and reduction
ranked.summary: Omics regression and dimension reduction increasingly need structure inferred from data rather than fixed in advance.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and imaging data are mined to prioritize cancer target candidates
ranked.summary: Large curated resources and imaging-omics models now connect patient-scale data to candidate biomarkers and drivers across tumor types.

ranked.headline: Inferring network topology from microbial gene transfer and amplicon sequence data
ranked.summary: Network-based inference is now applied to separate direct from indirect bacterial gene transfers and to group amplicon variants into empirical units.

ranked.headline: Regime boundaries in bioelectric, aggregation, and mutation-driven aging models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model bioelectric, aggregation, hormonal, and somatic-mutation transitions that define disease onset and lifespan limits.

ranked.headline: Faster Fragment Docking, MD, and ML Potentials for Binding Mode Prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work speeds binding site identification, docking, and virtual screening through enhanced sampling, neural network potentials, and force field parameter…

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks with multimodal fusion predict diverse drug-discovery endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs molecular graph learning with fingerprints, descriptors, or images to predict activity, toxicity, and synergy endpoints.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked computational workflows and pooled IP-MS advance proteomics inference
ranked.summary: Higher-throughput MS experiments demand benchmarked informatics workflows to establish the reliability of protein-level inference.

ranked.headline: Pretrained embeddings fused with deep predictors for protein and RNA site prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained language-model embeddings paired with contrastive fusion and deep predictors now target diverse site-level prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and alignment design shape phylogenetic inference accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks inference tools, tests HIV-1 alignment design, and adds lineage-based tree rooting and evaluation.

ranked.headline: Integrating heterogeneous biological data to constrain predictive models
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs explicit model structure with heterogeneous omics, microbiome, and multi-lab data for prediction, stratification, and calibration.

ranked.headline: Context-conditioned generators design molecules, peptides, and cell morphology profiles
ranked.summary: Four November 2025 preprints couple generative models to pocket, lead, prior, or expert-feedback information during the design process.

ranked.headline: Allosteric networks mediate ligand recognition in laccase and p53 Y220C stabilizers
ranked.summary: Long-timescale MD and network analysis now resolve allosteric couplings that link ligand binding to conformational control in distinct protein systems.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide inference of duplication history, chromosome fusion and hybrid coupling
ranked.summary: Simulation-calibrated duplication metrics and hybrid coupling estimates now link genome architecture to speciation inference.

ranked.headline: Neural models learn isotropic and torsional representations of biomolecular structure
ranked.summary: Three November 2025 preprints apply learned models to MD trajectories, protein backbone generation and protein-ligand koff prediction.

ranked.headline: Software exposes gene loss, pseudoknot layers and recombination graphs for inspection
ranked.summary: Interpreting gene loss, RNA 3D topology and inferred recombination histories increasingly depends on interactive, layer-resolved visualization tools.
